scenarios.name: Toggle full and tabs-only display by double-clicking the active tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab
the ribbon shows its tabs without permanent command groups
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab again
the full Tools command groups are visible again
